verdict.assessment: Solid, appropriately-sized introductory week that matches Priya’s availability and recent training minutes. Exercises are well-chosen for a first-time program using dumbbells and a bench, and the mix of two harder strength days, a lighter stability session, and a mobility day is sensible for recovery and skill acquisition. The plan would benefit from clearer load/progression guidance (warm-up sets, target RPE, what ‘10 reps’ means for unilateral work), and a couple small technique/variation notes to protect form and improve long-term adaptation. Overall ready to use with brief fixes to ensure consistent progression and clarity for a beginner.
verdict.top_fix: Add explicit load and progression rules to each session (warm-up sets, choose a weight that hits 8 reps with the last 2 reps challenging ≈ RPE 7–8, clarify rep counts per side, and prescribe weekly progression—e.g., add 1–2 reps or 2–5% weight when target reps are achieved for two sessions).
